title: Screen: no thirteen-call five-SWAP word with commuting projectors (scoped negative, no new kappa)
head: 139779c86ba8215910117ddb383e4df007b23dcf
body:
## Summary

Complete exact screen of the pairwise-commuting projector subfamily for the strictly alternating thirteen-call candidate at five fully occupied coordinate-SWAP targets. Scoped negative result; **no new kappa**. The selected result, the selected bit supplier and `upstream/` are unchanged.

```text
formal F2[GL_2(F2)] model, t = r = 5 fully occupied SWAP roles
  -> predecessor uniform cut consequence: any saving word has q = 13, strictly alternating
  -> natural-quotient block equations: four mod-2 conditions per frame class
  -> commuting reduction (sign equation): coordinate frame of exactly 5 projectors, odd multiplicities
  -> every class needs >= 3 positions, so 13 positions cannot fill 5 classes
  -> zero admissible partitions; any 13-call escape must use noncommuting projectors
```

The new package is `research/fiveswap-alt13-commuting-screen/`. It answers the commuting part of open question 2 of [`research/four-swap-full-occupancy`](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2/research/four-swap-full-occupancy), whose uniform cut consequence isolates `q = 13`, strictly alternating, as the only candidate below the direct fifteen-call tariff at five roles. No predecessor implementation is imported.

Exact predecessor heads and sources:

- `research/four-swap-full-occupancy` (rotation step, uniform cut consequence, open question 2; Ross Richardson), on main at base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`.
- [PR 1722](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1722) (label saturation lemma; Ross Richardson), [PR 1333](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1333) (scalar normalization; Gareth Davidson), [PR 1414](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1414)/[PR 1491](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1491) (model and sign invariant; commdata2338), [PR 1541](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1541) (workspace reasoning; Cinna Davis).
- `research/three-swap-cnot-census` and `research/three-swap-compression-seed6` (t = 3 closed at any workspace), `research/four-swap-r4-cnot` (t = 4 residual search).

The original `bit-new-register-model` draw is refined, not changed: the card's first experiment asks to price one smallest completed instance after a named changed premise; here the changed premise is the target-count boundary t = 5 left open by the predecessor's cut bound. Recent Q8/GL3 objects ([PR 2303](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2303), [PR 2248](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2248), [PR 2290](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2290), [PR 1974](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1974)) and a parallel agent's fresh Q8 claim were avoided; the scope choice is recorded in TASK.json.

## Evidence

Before: the strictly alternating thirteen-call word for t = 5 was an open candidate, with noncommuting scalar-projector interactions named as the blocker. After: the pairwise-commuting part is excluded by a written reduction plus a complete finite screen, and the block equations for the general noncommuting case are recorded as a handoff.

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/fiveswap-alt13-commuting-screen/verify.py
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fiveswap-alt13-commuting-screen
```

```text
PASS_FIVESWAP_ALT13_COMMUTING_SCREEN min_class=3 admissible_sets=1365 size_hist=3:91,5:455,7:546,9:247,11:26 partitions5=0 direct15_partitions=608 small_pairs=2046 commuting_pairs=196 frames3=28 no_new_kappa
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/fiveswap-alt13-commuting-screen outcome=completed
```

Screen counts for the strictly alternating thirteen-label word (all 8,191 nonempty position sets checked exactly):

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---:|
| Admissible class sets | 1,365 |
| Minimum admissible class size | 3 |
| Admissible sets of size 3 | 91 |
| Admissible sets of size 5 | 455 |
| Admissible sets of size 7 | 546 |
| Admissible sets of size 9 | 247 |
| Admissible sets of size 11 | 26 |
| Partitions into 5 admissible classes | 0 |
| Direct fifteen-call positive control partitions | 608 |

- Formal group-algebra product controls pass for the direct words at t = 1 (3 calls), t = 3 (9 calls) and t = 5 (15 calls); a mutated fifteen-call word fails the formal endpoint.
- Failure and scope controls: a size-one class is rejected; the universal size floor is exhaustive for every label word through length six (2,046 cases); an explicit noncommuting idempotent pair witnesses that the excluded family is strict; exhaustive commuting-pair orthogonality over F2^3 (28 rank-one idempotents, 196 commuting pairs) and 28 orthogonal frames support the reduction lemma.
- All 65 research workflow tests pass (`python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'`), 5 skipped as environment-dependent. `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/fiveswap-alt13-commuting-screen --check-only` prints `PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS`.
- The result is min-scope: `q >= 3t` for pairwise-commuting projectors at any fully occupied target count `t`, with the direct `3t` word attaining it. No kappa, supplier, frontier or general impossibility claim.

## Limitations and remaining obligations

- No noncommuting tuple search is attempted; the four block equations and the sign equation are the recorded handoff for that search. A thirteen-call escape may still exist with noncommuting projectors.
- No partial-occupancy claim (`r > t` restored dirty extras): at partial targets the predecessor's rotation and the block comparison change shape (its recorded workspace boundary).
- Author-checked only: no independent human review, no Lean formalization, no physical compilation, hosting, precision/tape, analytic transfer or selected-supplier cold replay. Finite checks in a declared subfamily are not a theorem about all words.
- `make` is unavailable on the recording host; the commands above are the underlying Python scripts.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** package

Only five new package files are added. No selected supplier, frontier record, frozen archive, shared checker or existing replay is changed.
